name: venvia-skills
description: Roy Chuang's public Claude Code skills.

plugins.name: git-persona-sheet
plugins.description: Profile a developer from git commit history against the five Cherny archetypes (Prototyper / Builder / Sweeper / Grower / Maintainer), score 0-10, and render an interactive inline-SVG radar build sheet across one or more repos.

plugins.name: github-gitlab-sync
plugins.description: Wire a GitHub-hosted repo to deploy through GitLab CI: mirror the repo, trigger the GitLab pipeline from GitHub Actions via royfw/gitlab-sync-action, and reflect the pipeline result back into the GitHub check.

plugins.name: changeset-release
plugins.description: Set up and debug the GitHub-native npm release path — Changesets versioning, release branches and prerelease channels, GitHub Actions version/publish workflows, dist-tags, and npm publish troubleshooting.

plugins.name: start-ts-by
plugins.description: Scaffold new projects from git repo or local folder templates with the start-ts-by CLI — template source formats, file filtering, package renaming, and post-create commands.
